test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:
He said he ___ the file by Friday, but he never did.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**', i.e., 'would submit'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence refers to an action in the **past** that was planned but never carried out.
 
• The correct construction in such cases is to use **"would + base verb"** to indicate the planned future action from a past perspective.
